identity.name: FieldCommand
identity.theme_strategy: Light Mode Default (High outdoor visibility). Dark Mode optional for Admin Dashboard.

dashboard_admin.container_class: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 p-6 max-w-[1600px] mx-auto
dashboard_admin.kpi_card: col-span-12 md:col-span-3 h-32 bg-white border border-slate-200 p-6 flex flex-col justify-between hover:border-slate-300 transition-colors
dashboard_admin.main_chart: col-span-12 md:col-span-8 row-span-2 bg-white border border-slate-200 p-6 h-[400px]
dashboard_admin.recent_list: col-span-12 md:col-span-4 row-span-2 bg-white border border-slate-200 p-0 overflow-hidden

mobile_technician.structure: Sticky Top Header + Scrollable Content + Sticky Bottom Nav
mobile_technician.card_style: bg-white p-4 mb-4 border border-slate-200 shadow-sm active:scale-[0.99] transition-transform
mobile_technician.primary_action: Fixed bottom-right FAB or full-width bottom sticky button
mobile_technician.thumb_zone: Critical actions (Status, Timer, Photos) must be in the bottom 40% of the screen

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground h-11 px-6 font-semibold hover:bg-primary/90 active:scale-95 transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 h-11 px-6 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:text-slate-900
buttons.destructive: bg-red-50 text-red-600 border border-red-100 h-11 hover:bg-red-100

inputs.base: h-11 border-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent/20 focus:border-accent bg-white
inputs.label: text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-1.5 block

tables.header: bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 text-slate-500 font-medium text-xs uppercase tracking-wider

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px or 2px. Consistent sizing (w-5 h-5 for buttons, w-6 h-6 for nav).

accessibility_rules.contrast: Text must maintain 4.5:1 ratio. Avoid light gray text on white.
accessibility_rules.touch_targets: All interactive elements on mobile must be at least 48x48px (including padding).
accessibility_rules.focus_states: Visible focus ring (ring-2 ring-accent ring-offset-2) for keyboard navigation.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. MOBILE FIRST: Build the Technician App views first. This is the hardest part to get right for this persona.
2. SIGNATURE PAD: Implement a real signature canvas for the 'Technician' flow. Do not mock this.
3. DENSITY: For the Admin Dashboard, do not waste space. Use table views with compact rows.
4. OFFLINE INDICATOR: Always show a 'Sync Status' indicator in the top right of the mobile app.
5. PDF PREVIEW: Use an iframe or a dedicated clean layout for 'Devis/Facture' preview.
6. USE SHADCN: Heavily rely on Shadcn components but override the 'rounded-xl' to 'rounded-md' for a more industrial look.
7. DATA-TESTID: Add data-testid to every button and input (e.g., 'login-submit', 'job-card-123').
